params.name: apiKey
params.description: Raw API key value to validate. Exactly one of apiKey or accessToken must be provided.

params.name: accessToken
params.description: OAuth access token to validate. Exactly one of apiKey or accessToken must be provided.

params.name: apiProductId
params.description: API product ID to check subscription for

items.docs: Internal endpoint used by ExtAuth to validate API keys and access tokens. Returns whether the credential is allowed and any associated metadata.
